operator: centered angular spectrum envelope, standard FFT DC
calibration: known synthetic reference field, common to HIO and ER
geometry: synthetic full circular facet; explicit cladding disk
camera: subpixel intensity average, fixed exposure from blank reference
support: common outer disk; individual core geometry not supplied to solver
truth_access: evaluation_only files; scorer only, no OS-enforced isolation
parameter_selection: fixed seed and final iteration; no truth-based selection
assumptions: scalar single-mode cores; diagonal transmission; sample at input facet; one polarization; free-space detection; mode width and noise chosen for pilot
pending: measured core map/mode radii; objective pupil and magnification; coupling, polarization drift, estimated reference calibration
units: meters, radians, relative field amplitude, photoelectrons
